typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Source as string,
		MaterialType as string,
		MaterialSubtype as string,
		MaterialCategory as string,
		RecordStatus as string,
		UsageStatus as string,
		InstanceCounts as integer,
		ActiveInstanceCounts as integer,
		MaterialID as integer,
		MaterialName as string,
		Manufacturer as string,
		Model as string,
		ExternalWidth as double,
		ExternalDepth as double,
		ExternalHeight as double,
		Weight as double,
		RUSize as double,
		LabPowerWatts as decimal(13,0),
		LAB_kw as decimal(8,4),
		MPAF_kw as decimal(8,4),
		CABMax_kw as double,
		PowerType as string,
		TotalPlugs as integer,
		RequiredPlugs as integer,
		StandardCopperPorts as integer,
		StandardFiberOpticPorts as integer,
		UndefinedPorts as integer,
		LastInsertBy as string,
		LastInsertDate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(IsBlankRow = iif((isNull(MaterialName) || trim(MaterialName) == ''), 1, 0)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn split(IsBlankRow == 0,IsBlankRow == 1, disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Process,Ignore,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Process sink(input(
		MaterialID as integer,
		MaterialCategory as string,
		LastInsertBy as string,
		Source as string,
		TotalPlugs as integer,
		CABMax_kw as double,
		MaterialType as string,
		LastInsertDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		LabPowerWatts as integer,
		Manufacturer as string,
		RequiredPlugs as integer,
		MaterialName as string,
		LAB_kw as double,
		RecordStatus as string,
		InstanceCounts as integer,
		StandardCopperPorts as integer,
		RUSize as double,
		ActiveInstanceCounts as integer,
		ExternalHeight as double,
		PowerType as string,
		Weight as double,
		UsageStatus as string,
		ExternalWidth as double,
		Model as string,
		ExternalDepth as double,
		UndefinedPorts as integer,
		MaterialSubtype as string,
		MPAF_kw as double,
		StandardFiberOpticPorts as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MaterialID,
		MaterialCategory,
		LastInsertBy,
		Source,
		TotalPlugs,
		CABMax_kw,
		MaterialType,
		LastInsertDate,
		LabPowerWatts,
		Manufacturer,
		RequiredPlugs,
		MaterialName,
		LAB_kw,
		RecordStatus,
		InstanceCounts,
		StandardCopperPorts,
		RUSize,
		ActiveInstanceCounts,
		ExternalHeight,
		PowerType,
		Weight,
		UsageStatus,
		ExternalWidth,
		Model,
		ExternalDepth,
		UndefinedPorts,
		MaterialSubtype,
		MPAF_kw,
		StandardFiberOpticPorts),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
